validation_queries.description: --cpu-metrics frequency,load must register a per-core cpu_frequency PMC
validation_queries.error_message: No cpu_frequency PMC registered; the frequency selection never reached the CPU collector
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM pmc_info WHERE name LIKE 'cpu_frequency%'

validation_queries.description: --cpu-metrics frequency,load must register a per-core cpu_load PMC
validation_queries.error_message: No cpu_load PMC registered; the load selection never reached the CPU collector
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM pmc_info WHERE name LIKE 'cpu_load%'

validation_queries.description: The registered cpu_frequency PMC must actually carry samples. Registering the PMC and then dropping every sample looks identical to a working run in any rule that only counts rocpd_pmc_event rows, because the thread_* metrics fill that table on their own
validation_queries.error_message: cpu_frequency is registered in pmc_info but has zero samples in rocpd_pmc_event. Check the run log for 'CPU PMC sample skipped: PMC info not registered'
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM rocpd_pmc_event E INNER JOIN pmc_info I ON I.id = E.pmc_id WHERE I.name LIKE 'cpu_frequency%'
